name: sanad
description: Sanad - Verified-scholars-only social and learning platform

scripts.build: npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.build:admin: npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/admin-portal run build
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/shared && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/mobile
